final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.telescref, o.weathprofile, AVG(s.modindex) as avg_modindex, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) as avg_phaseshiftdeg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY s.telescref, o.weathprofile), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(s.modindex) as overall_avg_modindex FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), step3 AS (SELECT step1.telescref, step1.weathprofile, step1.avg_modindex, step1.avg_phaseshiftdeg, step1.avg_modindex - step2.overall_avg_modindex as diff FROM step1, step2 WHERE step2.overall_avg_modindex IS NOT NULL AND step1.avg_modindex > step2.overall_avg_modindex) SELECT weathprofile, AVG(avg_modindex), AVG(avg_phaseshiftdeg), AVG(diff) FROM step3 GROUP BY weathprofile    -- groups by weather condition; returns avg modulation index, avg phase shift, and avg difference from overall mean
